lines: Meerkats want to hunt in a different place.
A few meerkats make a special sound.
If other meerkats agree, they make the same sound.
Honeybees want a new place to build a hive.
A bee dances after finding a new place.
If the other bees like the place, they dance, too.
ko: 미어캣은 다른 곳에서 사냥하고 싶어 한다.
다른 미어캣들도 찬성하면, 같은 소리를 낸다.
꿀벌은 벌집을 지을 새 장소를 원한다.
벌 한 마리가 새 장소를 찾은 후에 춤춘다.
다른 벌들이 그곳을 좋아하면, 그들도 춤춘다.
body.text: Meerkats want to hunt in a different place. Then they vote. A few meerkats make a special sound. If other meerkats agree, they make the same sound. Honeybees want a new place to build a hive. Then they vote. A bee dances after finding a new place. If the other bees like the place, they dance, too.
